# Set-Up

## Libraries

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Project Specific Functions

```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```


# Import Data

```{r}
rts <- read_sf("../RTSMapping_v2_products/2025q3/south_rts_candidates.gpkg")
```

# Prep Data

## Filter High Probability RTS

```{r}
rts_high <- rts |>
  filter(conf_class == "high") |>
  mutate(rts_id = as.integer(rts_id)) |> 
  st_transform(6931) # NSIDC EASE-Grid 2.0 North

rts_high_pt = rts_high |> 
  st_centroid()
```

# Save Output

```{r}
st_write(
  rts_high,
  "01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_poly.geojson"
)

st_write(
  rts_high_pt,
  "01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson"
)
```
